title: Patriot Cruises

services.name: Patriot Cruises
services.desc: Guests of all ages will delight in learning local history while experiencing breathtaking views on a 70-minute narrated cruise along the Miles River on a 65-foot, 149-passenger vessel built to resemble a traditional Chesapeake Bay steamboat. Tickets can be purchased in advance through the Patriot Cruises online portal
